dataset.name: heart_disease
notes: Remaining missing values are mean-imputed with training statistics.

preprocessing.fitted_on: union of client training partitions (== pooled training split)

communication.measurement: protobuf-serialised Flower message content (excl. gRPC/TLS/TCP framing)

privacy.guarantee: Record-level (example-level) (epsilon, delta)-DP for each institution's training records, add/remove-one-record adjacency, Opacus DP-SGD with Poisson sampling, RDP accountant, composed over every local step in every round the institution participated in. Not client-level DP. Does not cover preprocessing statistics or reported sample counts.
